hero.badge: Focus on the Game, Not the Admin
hero.title: Effortless Match-Day
hero.subtitle: Volunteer Coordination
hero.description: A streamlined tool for local handball clubs to organize officials, timekeepers, and court assistants. No accounts, no hassle—just high-performance management.

zero_friction.title: Zero Friction Signup
zero_friction.description: No logins, no passwords, no registration forms. Start managing your match-day immediately with local browser storage.

real_time.title: Real-time Sharing
real_time.description: Generate a unique link to share assignments with your team instantly. Works on any device, anywhere.

local_priority.title: Local Priority
local_priority.description: Your data stays in your browser. Private, secure, and fast.

club_custom.title: Club Custom
club_custom.description: Adapt roles for league matches, youth cups, or friendlies.

print_ready.title: Print Ready
print_ready.description: Export clean PDFs for physical match records and table duties.

cta_section.title: Ready to organize your next home game?
cta_section.description: Join over 50 local clubs streamlining their match-day logistics with Handball Helper.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.description: Manage and track volunteer roles for every match. Ensure all positions—from timekeepers to court assistants—are filled.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your central hub for managing upcoming gamedays. View your schedule and current assignments at a glance.

setup.title: Admin Setup
setup.description: Configure your club's settings, define roles, and import game schedules from iCal or manual entries.

step1.title: How would you like to start?
step1.description: Choose a method to create your season plan. You can edit everything later.

manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description: Configure your club and roles step by step yourself.

auto.title: NuLiga Import
auto.description: Import data directly from the NuLiga system (clubs, rosters, match days).

manual.title: General Configuration
manual.description: Enter your club's basic details and choose the required helper roles.

auto.title: Select Club
auto.description: Search for your club in the NuLiga system.

step3.title: Almost done!
step3.description: Your basic structure is ready. You can now add teams and refine the schedule in the dashboard.

timekeeper.name: Timekeeper
timekeeper.description: Responsible for the match clock, timeouts, and suspensions.

scorekeeper.name: Scorekeeper
scorekeeper.description: Maintains the official digital scoresheet and player performance logs.

floor_manager.name: Floor Manager
floor_manager.description: Coordinates court-side safety, ball management, and official protocols.

media_liaison.name: Media Liaison
media_liaison.description: Handles match recordings, live-stream moderation, and social updates.
